title: Japanese army cargo truck (enemy target)
type: Isuzu Type 94 six-wheeled truck (cargo truck), assumed
notes: Built to the real type's size in the game (VM REAL in the vehicle models): the body, without aerials, flag staffs and other thin parts, is scaled to the reference length, width and height.
Height is measured on the body; the drawing's overall height also includes the aerial or staff where the model has one.
The reference height (2.7 m) is with the canvas tilt; a model without a tilt keeps its own proportions, so it is lower.

measure.Height: (()=>{const b=new THREE.Box3(),t=new THREE.Box3();for(const q of VM.fitParts('truck')){if(!q.g.boundingBox)q.g.computeBoundingBox();t.copy(q.g.boundingBox).applyMatrix4(q.m||new THREE.Matrix4());if(Math.max(t.max.x-t.min.x,t.max.z-t.min.z)<0.15)continue;b.union(t);}return b.max.y-b.min.y;})()
